description: CLK1 (2m, the wanted signal is the fundamental) through a cheap band-pass filter marked 137M/140M and a measured 37 dB pad set

chain.name: LC band-pass 137M/140M
chain.notes: L-C-L-C-L in series with capacitors to ground at each junction; the marking is below the 2m band (144-146 MHz) but the filter is expected to pass it; response not yet measured

chain.name: pad set
chain.notes: measured, not the labels: the 27-33-27 ohm T pad (15 dB) in series with the BNC attenuator marked 10 dB (really 27 dB), joined with SMA/BNC adapters. Measured together without a filter on 2026-10-31 as 37.4 dB at 145 MHz (36.9 to 38.4 dB from 20 to 180 MHz).

notes: The pad value is the loss measured at 145 MHz from a straight cable (with the same adapters) at 2 mA. The same pad set was used for the 6m baseline, so levels are comparable between the two bands.
